newsitem.title: USA: Rap music star Tupac Shakur shot in Las Vegas.
newsitem.headline: Rap music star Tupac Shakur shot in Las Vegas.

text.p: Rap music star Tupac Shakur was shot and seriously wounded in his car near the famed Las Vegas Strip, police said on Sunday.

Shakur, 25, who was in Las Vegas to attend the Mike Tyson-Bruce Seldon boxing match, underwent emergency surgery at University Medical Centre early Sunday following the shooting late Saturday night, police said in a statement.
Shakur was headed for a local nightclub with a group of his friends when four people in a white Cadillac pulled up alongside his car and opened fire, authorities said.

Shakur was hit several times and his injuries "were considered serious," police said. Marion Knight, 31, reportedly Shakur's bodyguard, received a minor wound to the head and was expected to be treated and released.
Police said the suspects were still being sought.
